description: Authored New Scene original visual World shadow casters; no collision meshes, proxy bounds, LOD simplification, or Character subtree.

conventions.matrices: column-major float32, local-to-world; geometry remains model primitive local
conventions.geometry: Original glTF POSITION and triangle index accessors; NORMAL normalized as ModelAsset.cpp; tangent-only vertex reindexing preserves these triangle attributes.
conventions.numericEncoding: Up to9 significant decimal digits; each literal verified to round-trip the original IEEE754 float32 bit pattern without quantization.
conventions.materials: Authored native Output constants/flags and graph digest; texture pixels/graph evaluation intentionally not embedded. All current caster materials are opaque.
